notes:
Fixed tracks per channel: click a role, then set a channel to "+ new named track" (for example recorder ch 1 -> Boom). It lands on that track in every export.
Each group's Tracks panel lists its named tracks (rename, reorder) and chooses Pack or Checkerboard for the rest.
Nudge a role by frames to fix sync, and set a different start timecode under Settings.
Presets remember all of it.
